```{r}
combined <- bat %>%
  left_join(field, by = "Tm") %>%
  left_join(pitch, by = "Tm") %>%
  left_join(pos, by = "Tm")

head(combined)

write.csv(combined, "combined_teams.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
